# `TargetChange`

<!-- Generated by tools/gen_cards.py from catalog/. Do not edit by hand. -->

Legacy autosave plan moved to another target (no members).

## Summary

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Kind | event (device sends) |
| Grade | PURE GETTER (observation only; receiving the event changes nothing) |
| Side-effect tier | B |
| Confidence | READ |
| Basis | static analysis of firmware 9.31, AutoSavePlan @0x30ea00 (64-bit build); 32-bit counterpart present |

N family: only Event and Timestamp. Sent by the legacy autosave plan worker when its current target changes. Broadcast on TCP 4700 to every retained socket. The event carries no target data; read get_app_state progress.cur_target to learn the new target. No APK consumer is established. A 32-bit counterpart emitter exists.

Side effects: None for the receiver; the device sends this without a request.

## Request params

None. Events are sent by the device without a request; the payload is below.

## Payload

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Event` | string | yes | - | Discriminator. Fixed value `"TargetChange"`. [READ] |
| `Timestamp` | string | yes | - | Decimal string with nine fractional digits from a monotonic clock; not a calendar time. [READ] |

## Errors

None. Failures appear in the payload (`code`, `error`) when `state` is `fail`.

## Example

Event, bare - The only shape (READ; value invented):

```json
{"Event":"TargetChange","Timestamp":"1234.123456789"}
```
